manual_live_gate_requirements: Universe Core rollout governance approval for live-candidate stage

scoring_model.formula: score = impact + unblock_value + safety_value - effort_cost - blocker_risk
scoring_model.dependency_rule: all phase dependencies must already be completed_additive

phases.title: Deterministic Intelligence Ledger Chain
phases.objective: Create a deterministic, replay-safe hash-chained ledger over advanced intelligence outputs so future simulation and capital governance remain auditable across identical world inputs.
acceptance_criteria: ledger identity is stable across identical world and intelligence payload inputs
ledger captures explicit veto lineage from phase32 and phase34
phase36 output is exported in advanced_intelligence and meta intelligence
rollout_constraints: advisory only; cannot alter live execution authority
bounded memory and deterministic hashing only
strict_completion_requirements: full pytest green after phase36 integration
backlog status updated to completed_additive only with test evidence

phases.title: Scenario Portfolio Netting Engine
phases.objective: Net future-simulation branch outcomes across symbols into a bounded portfolio stress envelope before capital recommendation steps.
acceptance_criteria: netted envelope deterministic for same scenario tree set
exposure netting never exceeds existing risk caps
risk escalation reasons include portfolio netting evidence
strict_completion_requirements: phase37 focused and full regression gates green
rollback notes include netting-module disable path

phases.title: Capital Constraint Compiler
phases.objective: Compile survival doctrine, risk caps, and execution limits into a single deterministic capital constraint contract used by downstream intelligence phases.
acceptance_criteria: compiled constraints are deterministic from fixed inputs
safety veto in survival doctrine hard-clamps exposure in compiled contract
constraint contract is serializable and machine-readable
strict_completion_requirements: constraint contract enforced in tests for veto and normal modes

phases.title: Global Market Brain Calibration and Drift Sentinel
phases.objective: Add calibration and drift monitors for GlobalMarketBrain outputs so confidence and freshness are bounded and replay-stable.
acceptance_criteria: drift scores deterministic on replay
stale data lowers confidence with explicit reason codes
calibration artifact exposed in ops payload
rollout_constraints: confidence can only decrease on missing critical inputs
no runtime dependence on external non-deterministic services

phases.title: Cross-Reality Integrity Guard
phases.objective: Harden cross-reality fusion with explicit integrity thresholds and fail-closed degradation contracts for high-uncertainty regimes.
acceptance_criteria: integrity guard deterministically flags low-coverage states
guard escalation is exported with reason codes
survival doctrine consumes integrity escalation when available
rollout_constraints: no silent override of hard safety stop
strict_completion_requirements: cross-reality degradation contract validated by tests

phases.title: Personality Stability Governor
phases.objective: Introduce bounded personality state transition governance to prevent unsafe oscillations under repeated stress cycles.
acceptance_criteria: transition budget deterministic for identical stress sequences
hard safety override still forces survival posture
stability violations surfaced in advanced intelligence
rollout_constraints: cannot allow transitions that weaken hard-stop semantics

phases.title: Committee Escalation Protocol
phases.objective: Formalize committee disagreement escalation and operator-facing veto rationale bundles for institutional governance readiness.
acceptance_criteria: veto/disagreement escalation bundle is deterministic and machine-readable
safety veto always propagates into escalation ticket
ops snapshot includes escalation summary
rollout_constraints: no automatic live activation from committee output

phases.title: Institutional Gate Compiler
phases.objective: Compile institutional readiness, ops governance, and committee veto status into a single deployment gate contract.
acceptance_criteria: deployment gate reflects veto/manual gate truth deterministically
gate blockers are explicit and machine-readable
rollout stage cannot advance when required controls are missing

phases.title: Macro-to-Micro Decision Bridge
phases.objective: Bridge macro global-market context to micro execution posture through typed, deterministic contraction logic.
acceptance_criteria: bridge decisions deterministic and serializable
high macro stress contracts micro risk/size posture
no bypass of existing shield/profit-floor checks
rollout_constraints: bridge is advisory in additive path
existing execution authority and risk guards remain unchanged

phases.title: Future Simulation Ensemble Ladder
phases.objective: Extend deterministic future simulation to bounded multi-tree ensemble evaluation for robust tail-risk and edge confidence estimation.
acceptance_criteria: ensemble seeds deterministic across identical inputs
compute is bounded by explicit branch and tree limits
ensemble export remains machine-serializable for replay
strict_completion_requirements: ensemble determinism and bounds tests pass

phases.title: Causal Twin Coupling Layer
phases.objective: Connect phase29/45 simulation outputs with causal market twin diagnostics to improve structural scenario credibility without introducing nondeterminism.
acceptance_criteria: alignment score deterministic from fixed twin/simulation payloads
divergence reasons are explicit and serializable
fallback behavior is conservative when twin inputs are stale
rollout_constraints: fail-closed on stale or partial twin critical data
strict_completion_requirements: causal alignment and stale-input tests pass

phases.title: Distributed Deterministic Simulation Bridge
phases.objective: Add deterministic sharded simulation contract support through distributed compute bridge while preserving replay identity and bounded execution.
acceptance_criteria: same input contract yields same shard identities and aggregate output
distributed timeout/partial failure paths are explicit and conservative
replay metadata includes deterministic shard evidence
rollout_constraints: distributed bridge cannot change live execution authority
must remain safe under worker unavailability

phases.title: Evidence Vault and Audit Replay Index
phases.objective: Build a machine-readable evidence vault index linking decisions, simulations, vetoes, and ops artifacts for institutional audit replay.
required_modules_contracts: integration with memory.py and ops.py artifacts
acceptance_criteria: evidence index deterministically references packet and governance artifacts
missing artifacts are explicitly marked and fail readiness checks
index is serializable and bounded
rollout_constraints: no hidden mutable state outside persisted artifacts

phases.title: Live Canary Governance Envelope
phases.objective: Compose canary rollout governance envelope from readiness, survival, committee, and evidence signals with explicit manual gate lock.
acceptance_criteria: canary envelope deterministically blocks when manual gate or veto conditions fail
envelope checklist is machine-readable and complete
rollout stage transitions remain fail-closed
strict_completion_requirements: canary envelope and gate-lock tests pass

phases.title: Institutional Autonomous Capital Certification
phases.objective: Produce a deterministic certification dossier for window 36-50 with residual-risk register, rollback packet, and readiness truth table.
acceptance_criteria: certification dossier is machine-readable and reproducible
residual risks and rollback controls are explicit
recommended_next_phase is null only when all window phases are complete
rollout_constraints: cannot claim live readiness without manual gate + safety evidence
